Headline: Gate Event Contracts Limited-Time Trading Competition Round 3: New User First Trade Reward, Win Up t...

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Gate Event Contracts Limited-Time Trading Competition Round 3 is now live, with increased rewards. New Event Contracts users can receive 5.5 USDT after completing their first qualifying trade. All users can claim tiered rewards by meeting the daily trading requirement, up to 2,400 USDT. Users with a cumulative trading volume of ≥ 600,000 USDT can also qualify for the Peak Leaderboard and share rewards based on trading volume ranking. Trade short-term price movements for generous rewards.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 19, 2026, 10:00 (UTC) – November 26, 2026, 10:00 (UTC)
Important: Daily check-ins and trading volume requirements for the event are calculated based on UTC calendar days.
## Reward 1: Peak Leaderboard
During the event, users with a cumulative Event Contracts trading volume of ≥ 600,000 USDT will share the following rewards based on their trading volume rankings:
Ranking | Reward (USDT)
TOP 1 | 5,000
TOP 2 | 4,000
TOP 3 | 3,000
TOP 4–10 | 2,000 per person
## Reward 2: Get 5.5 USDT on Your First Trade
During the event period, users who complete their first Event Contracts trade with a first trade volume of at least 20 USDT can claim a 5.5 USDT Event Contracts Voucher. The voucher is issued upon completion, on a first-come, first-served basis.
## Reward 3: Check In for Guaranteed Rewards of Up to 2,400 USDT
Tiered rewards will be distributed based on daily Event Contracts trading volume:
Daily Trading Volume (USDT) | Daily Guaranteed Reward (USDT)
60,000 | 300
40,000 | 200
20,000 | 100
10,000 | 50
5,000 | 25
1,000 | 5
500 | 2.5
## Rules
Only one reward tier may be claimed per day; rewards cannot be combined.
During the event, users must meet the requirements of any tier for at least 4 valid days to receive a reward; only the highest reward will be distributed.
## Reward Claiming Instructions
Reward 2, the New User First Order Reward, can be claimed together with either Reward 1 or Reward 3. Rewards 1 and 3 cannot be claimed together.
After the campaign ends, the system will automatically compare all rewards a user is eligible for and distribute only the highest-value reward tier. Multiple reward tiers cannot be claimed simultaneously.
## What are Event Contracts?
Event Contracts are a trading product centered on predicting price direction. Simply determine whether the underlying asset's price will rise or fall over a future period, such as 5 or 15 minutes, select Bullish or Bearish, enter your amount, and submit the order to trade.
Example: For the BTC 5-minute market from 14:10–14:15 (UTC), select Bullish if you expect the settlement price at 14:15 to be higher than the benchmark price at 14:10; otherwise, select Bearish. The system automatically settles when the period ends. Positions can be closed early, with Take-Profit (TP) and Stop-Loss (SL) settings available.
To learn more about the rules, please refer to Event Contracts FAQ.
## Notes
All participants must complete Identity Verification before claiming and using rewards.
Rewards are issued within 14 business days after the campaign. Participants in similar Gate campaigns may receive rewards from only one campaign.
Only users who register and trade Event Contracts during the event period are eligible for rewards. Only trading volume generated from registration until the end of the campaign will be counted.
All rewards for this event are issued as Event Contracts Vouchers. Reward 2 is issued immediately. Rewards 1 and 3 are issued after the event ends. The vouchers have a face value equivalent to USDT and can be used to trade Event Contracts at a 1:1 ratio. For eligible uses and expiration details, see the official Voucher Instructions.
Event Contracts Vouchers can now be viewed and used on the Web. The App must be updated to V8.34.0 or later.
Stock Event Contracts now support trading on the Web. To trade Stock Event Contract underlying assets on the App, update to v8.36.0 or above.

If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
The event prize pool is limited and will be distributed on a first-come, first-served basis until fully distributed.
Data displayed on the Event page is for reference only. Actual data is subject to system records.
Reward values shown on the Event page are estimates for reference only; actual rewards are subject to official distribution.
Event Contracts are high-risk innovative trading products and may experience significant price fluctuations. Users should participate cautiously after fully understanding the risks. When entering Event Contracts for the first time, users must read and confirm the relevant risk disclosures and the User agreement.

Gate reserves the right of final interpretation of this event and may amend the relevant terms or cancel the event without prior notice.

Task | Eligible tokens | Requirement | Additional reward per tier | Available spots
